title: Gulfstream Presbytery — Citation regarding Assignment from GA/Review of Presbytery Records
disposition_detail: The SJC found Gulfstream Presbytery’s response to its exceptions of substance acceptable, pending certification that the Presbytery had approved the response.
first_summary: The SJC considered whether Gulfstream Presbytery had adequately answered a BCO 40-5 citation concerning exceptions of substance in its records. It accepted Gulfstream’s response, subject to certification to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records.
summary: The SJC considered whether Gulfstream Presbytery had adequately answered a BCO 40-5 citation seeking a more acceptable response to exceptions of substance in its records. It found Gulfstream’s response acceptable, but only pending certification to the Committee on Review of Presbytery Records that the Presbytery had approved it. The decision does not describe the underlying exceptions or give further reasons for finding the response acceptable.

sources.supports: Case identity, collective consideration, BCO 40-5 citation, conditional acceptance, and adoption.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: Case 2010-18 is identified at printed p. 601, lines 11–12; the collective decision was adopted with 20 concurring and four absent at printed p. 602, lines 33 and 55–59.
evidence_notes.dispute: The citation sought a more acceptable response to Gulfstream’s exceptions of substance under RAO 16-10(c) and BCO 40-5 (printed p. 602, lines 37–40).
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: The SJC found Gulfstream’s response acceptable, pending certification that the Presbytery approved it (printed p. 602, lines 49–52). No further rationale is stated.
evidence_notes.qualifications: The acceptance was expressly conditional on certification; the source does not describe the underlying exceptions (printed p. 602, lines 39 and 51–52).
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No decision is incorporated by reference.

source_limits: The source reports a collective administrative decision for six cases and gives no details about Gulfstream’s underlying exceptions or the substance of its response.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the adequacy of Gulfstream’s response to record-review exceptions.
score_reasons.decision: States the conditional acceptance without importing outcomes applicable to other presbyteries.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Faithfully notes that no rationale beyond acceptability is supplied.

score_reasons.economy: Retains only facts needed to explain the citation, result, and qualification.

verification_notes: Rechecked the collective judgment and corrected the synopsis to state that acceptance was conditional, not unconditional. Also confirmed that the minutes-forwarding ruling in line 53 did not include Gulfstream Presbytery.
